content: GOAL: Start review of five proposals against scope contract and frozen evidence bundles. READ: the five proposal texts and their five evidence bundles (d69fbb2eeb4c9ab0 cohrank-curvature-sinkhorn-v1, 6b5ae2abeecaab25 CURV_COH_PREFIX_SINKHORN, df96b282930cef5f curvature-stratum-sinkhorn-v1, bc49cd02b60c2754 hyperbolic_behavior_curvature_sinkhorn_v1, 73aab3babfa88c58 scc-l1-curvcoherence). OBSERVED: all five share the identical sanity-check block: E11 PASS geometry_operator_valid, E12 FAIL behavior_dependency (a positive row scalar cannot move an arg-min), E13 PASS geometry_dependency (matched Euclidean intervention changed 1 top-1 index), E14 CANDIDATE_PATH_NOT_RUN. Also E5/E6 identical train-only stats (118315 edges, mean out deg 5.45; baseline SID same-first-prefix 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067) and identical Stage-3 ledger (best observed 0.0546 BRANCH_CONDITIONED_FRECHET_RESIDUAL, none at/above 0.065). REASONING: every bundle reports the generic behaviour-dependency proxy as FAIL, so differentiation must come from whether the proposal's own cost offset is codeword-dependent (can move the balanced plan) and from whether the design keeps the baseline's balanced assignment. Open: item-by-item scope compliance and ranking.

GOAL: Decide item-by-item scope compliance and ranking grounded in the bundles. READ: the five SPECIFICATION blocks and each bundle's E6/E11-E14 ledger lines. OBSERVED: (a) all bundles share E12 FAIL behavior_dependency (a positive row scalar cannot move an arg-min; only a codeword-dependent offset moved top-1 indices) so the only admissible behaviour injection is a CODE-INDEXED offset inside the balanced cost; (b) E13 PASS geometry_dependency (matched Euclidean control changed 1 top-1 index); (c) E14 CANDIDATE_PATH_NOT_RUN in all five, so joint reach is unproven for every candidate; (d) E6 baseline same-first-prefix 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067, i.e. the baseline prefix carries only a weak behaviour signal, so a level-1-only intervention is the proportionate (and lowest-risk) bet; (e) ledger: every behaviour/curvature-ish arm sits below 0.065 (BRANCH_CONDITIONED_FRECHET_RESIDUAL 0.0546, CURV-RESID-CONTRAST 0.0544, CONCMID-GEO-SID 0.0517, COOC_RANK_FRECHET 0.0500, BEHDIR-L4 0.0482, BRad-RQ 0.0306/0.0446), all marked comparable_to_frozen:false. REASONING: rank by (i) does the offset depend on the codeword (E12) and stay inside a verbatim Sinkhorn with the baseline hard rule, (ii) derived-not-tuned constants, (iii) minimality of added machinery. Result: 1 curvature-stratum-sinkhorn-v1 (only the level-1 cost matrix changes, no extra loss, quantile-init strata, beta=measured median, levels 2-3 untouched); 2 CURV_COH_PREFIX_SINKHORN (code-indexed a_k, median/stop-grad-derived weights, level-1 only); 3 cohrank-curvature-sinkhorn-v1 (derived medians but offset applied to all three levels; own hypothesis concedes balancing may erase it); 4 hyperbolic_behavior_curvature_sinkhorn_v1 (arbitrary-sign centred radius rhat_k, minibatch-induced-edge contrastive likely near-empty); 5 scc-l1-curvcoherence (self-admitted risk the capped offset is inert, double Sinkhorn, batch-median normalisation perturbs the baseline's effective entropy strength, circular buffered b_k). All five are in scope on switches/ablation-free design; none needs a sweep or a seed repeat. Open: none. ANSWER BLOCK follows in the next record.

FINAL ANSWER (complete ranking, one block).
{"ranking":[{"idea_id":"curvature-stratum-sinkhorn-v1","position":1,"reason":"Only object changed is the level-1 Sinkhorn cost: C_ik=d_c(exp_0^c(u_i),exp_0^c(q_k))-beta*(1-|rho_i-s_k|)*R_c with s_k=sigmoid(a_k) indexed by the CODE, which is exactly the codeword-dependent form the bundle's E12 FAIL says is the only one able to move an assignment, while E10/E7 keep the curvature fixed and the Sinkhorn marginals, tau, iterations and argmax-over-plan hard rule verbatim (scope point 6 satisfied); no extra loss term is added at all (unlike CURV_COH's alignment term, cohrank's L_curv and hyperbolic's homophily contrastive), beta=m/R_c is a measured batch median measured once and frozen and a_k init at quantiles is closed-form, so nothing is swept; level 1 only fits E6 (same-first-prefix 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067: a weak, prefix-local behaviour signal, not grounds for touching all levels); cost +3 to +6% on level-1 distances only and Stage 3 unchanged."},{"idea_id":"CURV_COH_PREFIX_SINKHORN","position":2,"reason":"Code-indexed offset C_ik=d_c(exp_0^c(z_i),exp_0^c(e_k))-lambda_b*s_i*tanh(sqrt(c)||e_k||) with a_k in (0,1) again passes E12's requirement of a codeword-dependent term and keeps the baseline Sinkhorn balancing with row-argmax of P (E9/E10, scope 6); lambda_b and lambda_curv are scale-matched by measured medians and a stop-gradient reconstruction ratio, so no value is tuned; placed second, not first, because it adds a second soft-plan alignment term whose w_ij=(1-2|s_i-s_j|) covariance can push a bimodal prefix split (its own risk list), and because fixed c=1.0 is a documented default rather than the measured curvature that cohrank and hyperbolic derive, while the E11 check only certifies the operator, not that c=1 is the right scale here."},{"idea_id":"cohrank-curvature-sinkhorn-v1","position":3,"reason":"In scope with a live coupling (per-code learned mu_k makes the cost offset codeword-dependent per E12, and beta_l=1.0*median min_k d_c at init is measured, s=0.25 is a documented Gaussian width), so the score enters inside a verbatim Sinkhorn with k_i=argmax_k P_ik rather than any argmin; placed only third because the offset is applied at all THREE levels rather than the level-1 prefix only, which contradicts E6's evidence that the behaviour signal is prefix-local (0.0907 vs 0.067) and puts L2/L3 reconstruction geometry at risk; its own hypothesis concedes the balance may erase the offset, and with one seed the E14 CANDIDATE_PATH_NOT_RUN joint-dependency question is compounded by three levels of changed cost."},{"idea_id":"hyperbolic_behavior_curvature_sinkhorn_v1","position":4,"reason":"Scope-compliant in form (curved d_c inside the level-1 Sinkhorn cost, behaviour offset rho_i*rhat_k, balanced Sinkhorn kept, hard index argmax of P, lambda=1 and D_med/c measured at step 0) but the weakest engineering grounding of the middle group: rhat_k is a CENTRED radius that takes either sign, so for half the codes the behaviour term fights the curved distance before the contrastive term can correct it (its own first two listed risks), and L_curv is computed over the graph edges INDUCED BY THE MINIBATCH, which at 118315 total edges over 24556 items is a very sparse, high-variance support, so the term may contribute almost no usable gradient; it also divides d_c by D_med, i.e. it rescales the distance the baseline's temperature was calibrated on."},{"idea_id":"scc-l1-curvcoherence","position":5,"rea

son":"In scope but the most likely to be inert or to perturb the baseline: the authors themselves record 'the derived offset cap (half the batch median curved distance) may be too weak to move any assignment, leaving the both-on run numerically close to behaviour-off: the mechanism would be inert', and unlike the others it normalises the curved cost by a batch median d_c, changing the effective entropy strength relative to the reference arm, which is the exact baseline property scope point 6 protects; it also needs a second full Sinkhorn pass and a self-referential buffered b_k=(s_old+sum P0 kappa)/(m_old+sum P0) that re-enters the next cost, adding moving parts that a single frozen run (no ablation, no seeds) cannot diagnose."}],"objection":"All five bundles carry the identical sanity block: E12 behavior_dependency FAIL (a positive row scalar cannot move an arg-min; only a codeword-dependent offset moved top-1 indices) and E14 CANDIDATE_PATH_NOT_RUN, so for every candidate the claim that behaviour actually reaches the balanced plan is asserted, not demonstrated; each proposal's own hypothesis names Sinkhorn balancing as the way the offset can be absorbed, and the frozen ledger gives no encouragement - every behaviour/curvature arm recorded (BRANCH_CONDITIONED_FRECHET_RESIDUAL 0.0546, CURV-RESID-CONTRAST 0.0544, CONCMID-GEO-SID 0.0517, COOC_RANK_FRECHET 0.0500, BEHDIR-L4 0.0482, BRad-RQ 0.0306/0.0446, all comparable_to_frozen:false) ends below the 0.065 target, so the difference between a ranked and an unranked candidate is design hygiene, not measured effect; with one run, one seed and no ablation the expected gain sits at or below seed noise, the baseline prefix-behaviour signal is already only 0.0907 against a 0.067 permuted null, and Gamma of these mechanisms is unlikely to be separable from noise."}
